data.name: ACE Ninja Path
data.detailed_description:
Ace Ninja Path is a 2D turn-based role-playing game where players control a ninja and take part in strategic battles.

Progress through the game by improving your character, unlocking different types of skills, and planning each turn carefully. Battles are turn-based, requiring thoughtful decisions to defeat enemies and move forward.

Players can unlock and use basic skills, special skills, and secret skills to adapt to different combat situations. The game also features companions that assist during battles and progression.

Customize your ninja with a variety of skins, allowing you to change your character’s appearance as you progress through the game.

Features:

• Turn-based combat gameplay

• Basic, special, and secret skills

• Companion system for battle support

• Character progression and stat upgrades

• Variety of character skins

• 2D visuals with smooth animations

• Challenging enemy encounters

Ace Ninja Path offers a focused turn-based experience for players who enjoy strategy and character progression.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows 7, Windows 8.1 Classic or Windows 10
  • Processor: 33GHz or faster x86-compatible processor, or Intel Atom™
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: No mature content (e.g. sexual assault/non-consensual sex, drug and alcohol abuse, or self-harm)
